intentions: Define and manage expense categories with unique names, descriptions, optional monthly budgets, and icons
Store and retrieve expenses with detailed metadata including amount in cents, date, category, payment method, and recurrence status
Enforce unique constraints on budget entries via (category_id, month) combination at the database level
Implement a robust SQLite-based repository pattern for category, expense, and budget data with CRUD and filtering capabilities
Provide business logic in a service layer that validates data, enforces budget constraints, and supports aggregation and reporting
Support filtering and querying expenses by category, date range, payment method, and recurrence
Enable monthly and yearly financial reporting with budget status indicators (on track, warning, exceeded)
Allow exporting filtered expense data to CSV files
Detect recurring expenses that match amount and category on a monthly basis
Build a CLI interface using Click with nested command groups for managing categories, budgets, and expenses
Ensure all monetary values are stored as integers (cents) to avoid floating-point errors
Use auto-incremented primary keys with optional ID fields in domain models
Implement custom exception classes for common errors: CategoryNotFoundError, ExpenseNotFoundError, BudgetExceededException
Enable foreign key constraints in SQLite to maintain referential integrity between models
Support optional parameters in queries and commands with default behavior returning all data when no filters are provided
